title: Pete LaCache and the Supreme Band
summary: Eddie asks whether anyone has told the interviewer about Pete LaCache, who played with the Supreme Band. The interviewer has not heard of him.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: Did I ever tell you about Pete LaCache? Pete? Pete. What was the last name? Honestor. He played with the Supreme Band. Uh-huh. Anybody ever tell you about that?
I didn't hear the last name. Pete LaCache.
Never heard of him. I think he's living. They're going to have an ordinary word.
